The plaint case, in short, is that the Kalu Sheikh, Korban Ali, Sheikh Rashid and Paranullah alias Pashanullah Sheikh the 4 brothers were owners in 3 annas share each and rest 4 annas belongs Yad Ali Sheikh in the land of CS khatian No. 24; that amongst them Kali Sheikh and Paranullah Sheikh are uterine brothers and Korban Ali Sheikh and Sheikh Rashid are step brothers; that Paranullah Sheikh died unmarried and thus Kalu Sheikh inherited his share and that thereafter Kalu Sheikh died leaving 2 sons Saheb Ali Sheikh and Rustom Ali Sheikh @ Nasiruddin and each of them got .21½ acres of land. 

 7. It is further stated that in SA operation, suit land recorded in khatian No. 501 and 502 and no one raised objection against such record; that Nasiruddin, the heir of Kalu Sheikh, inherited .27 acres of land who died leaving one son Abdur Rahim, one daughter Monowara and wife Zahura Khatun and thereafter Abdur Rahim died leaving mother, sister and uncle Saheb Ali and that Zahura Khatun and Monowara transferred their share in favour of defendant No. 4 and 10 and thus Saheb Ali acquired title over .29625 acres of land, and after the death of Saheb Ali his wife and 4 sons herited the suit land and out of them one son Abdur Rouf his share in favour of the defendant No.4 and acquired title over the suit land.
